about: Renders an icon at a size, in a text ink and with a motion. The component ships no artwork: pass paths as children or an icon component through `as`.

mirrored.about: An icon that points is mirrored in a right-to-left page. The arrow renders the same in this left-to-right page.
mirrored.title: Mirrored

motion.about: `spin` for loading, `float` for waiting and `twinkle` for something new. Each stops under reduced motion.
motion.title: Motion

size.about: The eight steps of the icon scale, and `inherit`, which is the height of the surrounding text.
size.title: Sizes

title: Icon

tone.about: Every text ink. `current` takes the ink of the surrounding text. The inverted ink is for a dark surface, so its cell renders on `bg.inverted`.
tone.title: Inks
